capabilities.description: Set wiper 0–1 through staged input_work; inspect/wait for completion. Preserves fresh transient charge/time/run.

id.description: Exact current component ID with kind potentiometer

position.description: Finite fraction: 0 toward pin 2, 1 toward pin 1; 0.5 represents 50%. Native percentage controls normalize to this fraction

completion.mode: changed fresh transient: immediate admission with asynchronous atomic input_work outcome; unchanged values may only supersede a matching pending request. Otherwise ordinary edit admission; inspect which path actually occurred

effects: Ordinary mutation guards and retry retention apply; a replay returns the original owned response, not current readiness
Inside edit.batch, these are ordinary startup configuration edits, not live actuation; changed running edits restart and paused edits stale results; undo/redo follow ordinary schematic history
A fresh network transient admits background input_work even while paused: solve at the committed simulated time with current capacitor voltages and previously applied switch states

Admission preserves committed graph/readings/history; requested_wiper is separate until successful atomic publication. Success commits the wiper, one actor-attributed undo entry and both sides of its event, preserving charge/time/run/electrical revision
New changed requests supersede active input/manual-step work. Setting the already committed position is a no-op except that it supersedes an active wiper request for the same potentiometer
Failure/cancel/supersession leaves committed wiper/charge/time/history intact; only the latest input_work is retained; old retired jobs cannot publish
Inspect input_work until completed before a dependent Step. Cancel through simulation.work.cancel with the exact active input_work.id; Pause also requests cancellation
DC, stale or incomplete drawings use ordinary electrical edit/restart/paused-stale behavior. Save/Verify capture committed wiper/startup, not a staged request or live movement history

errors.when: Malformed/missing input, wrong or unknown target kind/ID, or invalid value
Algebraic staging fails or its cooperative deadline expires
A newer request, committed-position cancellation, switch/input/source edit, run or document invalidates the captured job

preconditions: Target is an existing component of the declared kind; incomplete/stale/DC drawings may be configured
Fresh network transient means snapshot.transient is initialized and not stale, with a fresh network state; running and paused both qualify

input_schema.x-interaction-summary: Current transient readings: movement updates at the same time after calculation, preserving capacitor voltage. Paused stale readings refresh on Restart or Resume.
input_schema.x-work-inventory: Latest snapshot.input_work only; require matching ID, command and requested_wiper before attributing a retained outcome. Fallback edits do not create a new input job

mutation_preconditions.combination: A revision guard is required; all supplied revision/document guards must match
mutation_preconditions.expected_command_revision: Guards admitted commands, including other actors; live solver publication does not invalidate it
mutation_preconditions.expected_document_generation: Optional mutation context guard; prevents applying an old rendered action to a replacement document, including background publication
mutation_preconditions.expected_revision: Guards all state publication, including live samples

potentiometer.wiper.set.retry_retention: Latest 256 successful mutation keys per session; reconnect to the same process preserves them. Expired keys have no deduplication guarantee.

capabilities.description: Set desired SPST state; queue/coalesce fresh transient actuation without losing charge/run. Inspect desired/applied/pending state.

closed.description: Required Boolean saved desired startup state; false opens, true closes

id.description: Exact current component ID with kind switch

completion.mode: changed fresh transient: desired-state admission immediately; application waits for a subsequent successful sample. Otherwise ordinary startup edit/initialization; unchanged values preserve the applied state. Inspect switch_states and readiness for the actual path

effects: Ordinary mutation guards and retry retention apply; a replay returns the original owned response, not current readiness
Inside edit.batch, these are ordinary startup configuration edits, not live actuation; changed running edits restart and paused edits stale results; undo/redo follow ordinary schematic history
A fresh network transient commits the saved desired state and one undo entry immediately, preserving accepted time/charge/run/electrical revision; actuation revision changes separately

All pending switches apply as one staged group after the next accepted output sample advances the old applied circuit; a failed/canceled advance publishes neither partial time nor partial switch application
Paused changes remain pending until Step/Resume; simulation.wait alone does not advance time or apply a pending switch
Repeated desired values are no-ops; toggles coalesce to the final desired Boolean; returning to the applied state cancels that pending change
No separate input_work is launched; a changed desired state supersedes active input/manual-step work. Restart consumes the saved desired startup states at time zero
DC, stale or incomplete changes use ordinary electrical edit/restart/paused-stale behavior. Save/Verify capture desired startup states; live symbol/readings follow applied state

errors.when: Malformed/missing input, wrong or unknown target kind/ID, or invalid value
Later sample/event solve fails; inspect the resulting work/diagnostic rather than attributing failure to desired-state admission
Later sample exceeds the shared integration-attempt budget
Later sample exceeds the shared integration wall-time budget

input_schema.x-state-inventory: snapshot.switch_states: desired_closed, optional applied_closed, pending; absent applied state means no fresh applied reading
